arabic text: APNI GURBAT CHUPA RAHE HAI ALI
english translation text: Ali is building Zahra's grave while concealing his own loneliness.

arabic text: KYU KAMAR JHUK GAYI HAI MAULA KI\nKISKI MAYYAT UTHA RAHE HAI ALI
english translation text: Why has the Maula's back become bent?\nWhose body is Ali carrying?

arabic text: WAQTE TALQEEN ZAKHMI SHANO KO\nDHEERE DHEERE HILA RAHE HAI.\nAPNI GURBAT CHUPA RAHE HAI ALI
english translation text: At the time of talqin, he gently moves\nher wounded shoulders.\nAli is concealing his loneliness.

arabic text: HAYE SAMNA HOGAYA HAI QUNFUZ SE\nSABR KO AAZMA RAHE HAI ALI\nAPNI GURBAT CHUPA RAHE HAI ALI
english translation text: Alas, he has come face to face with Qunfuz.\nAli is putting his patience to the test.\nAli is concealing his loneliness.

arabic text: APNI GARDAN PE NEEL RASSI KA\nBETIYO SE CHUPA RAHE HAI ALI\nAPNI GURBAT CHUPA RAHE HAI ALI
english translation text: The rope-mark upon his neck\nhe hides from his daughters.\nAli is concealing his loneliness.

arabic text: RAAT HOGI TOH DEGE GHUSL O KAFAN\nAASMA DEKHE JAA RAHE HAI ALI\nAPNI GURBAT CHUPA RAHE HAI ALI
english translation text: When night arrives, he will give her ghusl and shroud.\nAli keeps looking towards the sky.\nAli is concealing his loneliness.

arabic text: HAYE DETE JATE HAI GHUSL BIBI KO\nHICHKIYA LETE JAA RAHE HAI ALI\nAPNI GURBAT CHUPA RAHE HAI ALI
english translation text: Alas, as he gives the Lady ghusl,\nAli continues to sob.\nAli is concealing his loneliness.

arabic text: AISA GUM HAI JO AAJ CHALTE HUE\nBARHA LADKHADA RAHE HAI ALI\nAPNI GURBAT CHUPA RAHE HAI ALI
english translation text: Such is the grief that even while walking,\nAli repeatedly stumbles.\nAli is concealing his loneliness.

arabic text: KAISI NEMAT SE HOGAYE MEHROOM\nHATH KYU MALTE JAA RAHE HAI ALI\nAPNI GURBAT CHUPA RAHE HAI ALI
english translation text: From what immense blessing has he been deprived?\nWhy does Ali keep rubbing his hands?\nAli is concealing his loneliness.

arabic text: EK ZAHRA EK APNI GURBAT KA\nDO JANAZE UTHA RAHE HAI ALI\nAPNI GURBAT CHUPA RAHE HAI ALI
english translation text: One funeral is Zahra's, and one is his own loneliness.\nAli carries two funeral biers.\nAli is concealing his loneliness.

arabic text: AY TAKALLUM BATUL KE GHAM ME\nAB BHI AASU BAHA RAHE HAI ALI\nAPNI GURBAT CHUPA RAHE HAI ALI
english translation text: O Taqallum, even now in Batul's grief,\nAli continues to shed tears.\nAli is concealing his loneliness.
